text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this clinic and feel it’s important to warn others.

The pricing is extremely misleading. The prices advertised online are very different from what you are actually charged in person. There also seems to be no consistent pricing structure—multiple different prices are quoted for the same treatments, and it is unclear what basis is used to determine the final cost. Overall, this appears to be a price-driven business rather than a patient-focused clinic, with emphasis on selling rather than care. I also question the authenticity of many of the positive reviews here…

In my case, I paid for a full legs laser hair removal treatment, which was already expensive(6,500THB+). During the session, I asked if my feet could be done and was told “no problem,” with no mention of any extra charge. After the treatment, I was given a significantly higher bill just for that small area, which was never disclosed upfront

They also advertised Alexandrite laser to me, but the treatment provided was diode laser

Overall, I would strongly advise others to be cautious  and choose the clinic that care, not just sell.

Every session, the doctor was late and each one ran shorter than the previous. On one session they burned her so badly that she developed bad blistering.

The final session was a joke. Doctor was sixteen minutes late, and when my girlfriend was taken inside the lights in the room were broken. The doctor used one hand for the laser and the other to hold her phone light on my girlfriend's leg.

After four minutes, she gave up and told my girlfriend to book another appointment, before literally running out of the office to meet her friends.

On trying to book a replacement appointment we were told that we would have to PAY for it. The receptionist adamantly refused to listen, and refused to call the doctor. Eventually she said that she would talk to the doctor and call us - we left our number. That was over two months ago and we haven't received any call.

Oh, and the dark spots? Still there, no change.

Avoid this outlet at all costs. The fact that it has such a high star ranking has to be due to bots; I can think of no other reason. Go to a clinic on the Festival side - at least they don't lie to your face.
